skill_name: Write a letter to a friend explaining the merits of a healthy lifestyle.
workflow:
Dear Friend, 

Living a healthy lifestyle has so many benefits: it can help improve your physical and mental health, boost your energy, aid in preventing illnesses and diseases, and help you look and feel your best. Eating right and exercising regularly are important, but other habits like getting enough sleep and drinking plenty of water, managing your stress levels, and avoiding smoking and excessive alcohol consumption can all make a big impact.
